youtube.title: Why do some countries drive on the left? ⚔️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Most people are right-handed, and that may be why many travellers kept to the left. Ride on the left and your sword hand faces whoever is coming the other way. A right-handed rider also climbs onto a horse from the left, which is easier from the side of the road. Nobody can prove it, but it fits. Full episode on the channel.

instagram.caption: You never think about which side of the road you use, until you fly to London. One famous theory says it all started with swords and horses. Nobody can prove it, but it fits. Follow for more hidden whys. #thehiddenwhy #History #Shorts #Curiosity
